About Me

Behind every strong online presence, there's a thoughtful strategy. That's where I do my best work. I help brands turn structure into clarity by combining creative digital marketing with organized, reliable systems. As a Digital Marketing Consultant and Virtual Assistant with over a year of hands-on experience, I support businesses with content creation, social media management and executive support. Through ALX Africa's AI Career Essentials program, I've learned to use AI tools to work smarter. Proficient in Canva, Meta Business Suite, and Google Workspace, and experienced with ChatGPT, Canva Magic Studio, Notion AI, DeepSeek, Pictory AI and more. I'm currently open to freelance remote opportunities where I can help businesses stay organized, grow their digital presence, and turn strategy into results.
